breaking.change: Replaces the raycast controller with substep wheel angular dynamics and combined-slip tyres. Grip is the actual tyre friction coefficient times ground friction, without hidden multipliers. engineForce and brakeForce are wheel torques in N·m in both profiles. suspensionDamping and driftGrip are deleted. Adds compressionDamping, reboundDamping, bumpStopStiffness, antiRollStiffness, brakeBias, wheelCast, aeroDrag, aeroDownforce, rollingResistance, ackermann, steeringFade, abs and tcs; new numbers are off at zero. Physics snapshots containing vehicles use the new wheel state without migration.
breaking.fix: Retune wheel torques and use grip around 1–1.5 for road tyres on friction-1 ground. Set compressionDamping and reboundDamping explicitly instead of suspensionDamping; remove driftGrip and tune real grip and handbrakeGrip. Opt into suspension, steering, aero and driving assists with nonzero values. Start new saves.

breaking.change: The drivetrain couples an engine flywheel through a clutch to measured wheel angular speeds, with gearbox hysteresis and one direction transition. Adds engineInertia, clutchStrength, engineBraking, differential, differentialStrength and awdBias. The handbrake no longer discards engine torque.
breaking.fix: Set nonzero engineInertia (kg·m²) and clutchStrength (N·m) to enable drivetrain drive. Select open, lsd or locked differential; set differentialStrength for LSD. Zero axle/brake bias means equal per-wheel torque; positive values are front-axle shares.

breaking.change: Supports up to sixteen wheels in both profiles with in-place geometry and grip updates. Adds an explicit chassis-local mount and separate compressionDamping/reboundDamping; deletes suspensionDamping. Zero mount captures the initial local Transform once, independent of visual pose updates.
breaking.fix: Author mount explicitly for multi-axle vehicles and copy vehicleWheels poses to game-owned visual Transforms. Replace suspensionDamping with explicit compressionDamping and reboundDamping.

breaking.change: Adds suspensionCompression, load, contactPoint, contactNormal, groundEntity and angularVelocity. Slip is measured from wheel/ground relative motion in both profiles, not the old skid multiplier.
breaking.fix: Use contact and load to gate road effects, contactPoint/contactNormal and groundEntity for marks and material sounds, and angularVelocity for wheel-speed telemetry.
